note: Affiliate-network site-ownership verification files. Each network hands us an exact byte payload and a fixed URL; the network's crawler fetches that URL and compares the body verbatim. They are BUILD SOURCE, not hand-placed files: build-staging.mjs emits them exactly like the IndexNow key file, so a clean rebuild from source regenerates every one of them. They are excluded from the sitemap and served noindex - they are machine-verification endpoints, not pages for readers.
